summary.text: Regina Young is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 185, which she has represented since December 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Her career experience includes working as a community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Young was born in New Haven, Connecticut, and earned a bachelor's degree from Central Connecticut State University in 1996.
She earned an M.A. in community development from Eastern University.
Young assumed office in the House on December 1, 2020, succeeding Maria Donatucci.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Appropriations (as secretary), Labor & Industry, State Government, and Tourism & Recreational Development committees.
